# Henry Nicholson

> AI-forward Creative Developer & Designer based in San Diego. Junior Associate at Global Prairie; independent creator of Skinny Studio, vibechckd, LaunchPad, and other AI-forward products.

Henry Nicholson is a creative developer and designer working at the intersection of design, code, and AI. He is a Junior Associate at Global Prairie (a top 1% Certified B Corp, 100% employee-owned agency), supporting the sustainable and ethical adoption of AI across the organization's People & Operations team. Outside of Global Prairie, he builds independent AI-forward products under henrynicholson.dev.

## Current work

- **Global Prairie** — Junior Associate (Oct 2024–present). Focused on internal AI adoption, strategy, and workflow enablement.
- **Skinny Studio** (skinny.studio) — one of 20 AI-labeled apps published live in the Whop app store; a multi-modal, pay-per-usage creative AI tool with custom in-house tooling for creator workflows.
- **vibechckd** (vibechckd.cc) — a vetted freelancer marketplace with invoicing, payments, chat, and a job board, built front to back.
- **LaunchPad** — a Whop-embedded drag-and-drop landing page and funnel builder for SaaS and digital-offer creators.
- **Sevas.xyz** — a video-portfolio design system and CMS, currently run as the digital portfolio for a motion graphics artist whose work has supported Polymarket, Reflect (backed by a16z crypto), and other web3 startups.
- **ForeFront** (beforefront.com) — a student-teaching-students AI education platform, co-founded by Henry.
- **Zenvra** (usezenvra.com) — a tool combining software and proven methods to help students pay off loans faster.

## Past ventures

- **Chai Chata** (2023–2025) — creator and full-stack builder of a dorm-delivery beverage brand blending South Asian chai with Latin American horchata; built the ordering app front to back.
- **STEEZ** (2020–2024) — co-founder of a streetwear brand that shipped to customers internationally; built the e-commerce storefront front to back.
- **Out Of Style** (2022–2024) — founder and creative director of a nonprofit turning donated premium clothing into gifts for underserved youth.
- **Benilde-St. Margaret's School** (2022) — Creative Director; led the first redesign of the Boys Hockey Media Guide in 20 years, among the first high school programs to use generative AI (Midjourney) in production, raising over $30,000 in sponsorship revenue.

## Background

- Self-taught developer and designer; building on the internet since age 13.
- Studying Marketing at the University of San Diego (started September 2023).
- Based in the San Diego Metropolitan Area.
